functions.name: _require_read_boundary

functions.name: require_capacity_issuer_identity
calls:
conn.execute("SELECT session_user AS login,current_user AS role,
      current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,
      current_setting('search_path') AS path,current_setting('session_replication_role') AS replication,
      current_setting('aos.org_id',true) AS org,current_setting('aos.project_id',true) AS project,
      r.rolcanlogin,r.rolinherit,r.rolsuper,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolreplication,r.rolbypassrls,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_auth_members WHERE roleid=r.oid OR member=r.oid) AS members,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE relowner=r.oid) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE proowner=r.oid)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=r.oid) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datdba=r.oid) AS owned
      FROM pg_roles r WHERE rolname=current_user").fetchone

conn.execute("SELECT
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relowner=%s AND c.oid<>%s
        AND c.oid<>(SELECT reltoastrelid FROM pg_class WHERE oid=%s)
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid=c.oid AND i.indrelid IN(%s,(SELECT reltoastrelid FROM pg_class WHERE oid=%s))))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE proowner=%s AND NOT(oid=ANY(%s::oid[])))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=%s)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datdba=%s)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c,LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) a WHERE a.grantee=%s AND c.relowner<>%s)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute c,LATERAL aclexplode(c.attacl) a WHERE a.grantee=%s)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p,LATERAL aclexplode(p.proacl) a WHERE a.grantee=%s AND NOT(p.oid=ANY(%s::oid[])))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace n,LATERAL aclexplode(n.nspacl) a WHERE a.grantee=%s AND (n.nspname<>'public' OR a.privilege_type<>'USAGE' OR a.is_grantable))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.prosecdef AND has_function_privilege(%s,p.oid,'EXECUTE') AND NOT(p.oid=ANY(%s::oid[]))) AS extra", (role['oid'], table['oid'], table['oid'], table['oid'], table['oid'], role['oid'], list(ids.values()), role['oid'], role['oid'], role['oid'], role['oid'], role['oid'], role['oid'], list(ids.values()), role['oid'], role['oid'], list(ids.values()))).fetchone

conclusion: Original full approval guard composes Python checks; native byte-profile SQL alone supplies neither typed document validation nor approved claims, signer permission or atomic publication. Direct SQL ingress must independently enforce complete checks; caller flags and Python return values cannot authorize it.
